original_question:
Design a Verilog module named `shift_register`.
The module should have the following interface:
Inputs:
- `clk`: Clock signal
- `d`: Serial data input (1-bit)
Outputs:
- `q`: Serial data output (1-bit)

Implement a 3-bit synchronous register within this module. On every positive edge of the `clk` signal, the current contents of the 3-bit register should be shifted one position to the right. The new input bit `d` should be loaded into the least significant bit (LSB) position of the register during this shift. The output `q` should continuously reflect the current value stored in the least significant bit (LSB) of the 3-bit register.
